To calculate the lexical density of the provided text, we must first define the methodology. Lexical density is typically calculated as the ratio of content words (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs) to the total number of words in the text. Function words (pronouns, prepositions, conjunctions, articles, auxiliary verbs) are excluded from the content word count.
